name: files-caret
title: Typing at the end of a long note above its unfolded shelf (#329)
description: Design 6.5: the shelf lies at the bottom of the note's scrolling page, and the page keeps its height as scroll padding, so that the caret is brought into sight above it, never behind it. Lines are typed at the end of a long note with the shelf unfolded, and after each the caret's box is checked, as it is once the shelf has unfolded under a caret at the note's end (the page rides up with it, 6.5), against the shelf's top (`caretAbove`, which stops the run if it is behind). Desktop: a new note of forty lines and three pictures pasted onto it, its shelf (folded, 7.14) unfolded by its line. Android: the newest note must have three files or more (docs/ui/motion-check.md); it is opened, made long and unfolded, with the keyboard up all the while. The mockup has no long notes, so it is not compared.
